representation.X_F: ast001 neutral supplies the common vertex numbering and ordered oriented connectivity; it is not an anatomical ideal
representation.expression_reference: each subject's own neutral geometry, with shared connectivity
representation.Y: observed target surface, stored separately from the predicted correspondence
representation.Z: predicted mapped source vertices f(X), retaining source connectivity F; not available from an actual model in this S0
representation.baseline: dataset registered meshes are reference controls, not absolute semantic ground truth
representation.array_dtype: float64 coordinates; int64 zero-based triangle vertex indices
representation.topology_hash: SHA256 of little-endian int64 [vertex_count, face_count] and exact ordered zero-based face array; preserves winding

preprocessing.scale: preserve individual native scale; no per-sample size normalization
preprocessing.alignment: one proper rigid transform per subject, fitted from its neutral to ast001 neutral; apply the same transform to all its expressions and associated target/prediction geometry when needed
preprocessing.landmarks: native landmark frame is not assumed compatible; do not apply mesh transforms or use as independent ground truth before separate validation
preprocessing.transform_convention: row vectors: aligned = native @ R + t; native = aligned @ R.T - t @ R.T; vectors transform by R only
preprocessing.materialization: save forward/inverse transforms and verification statistics only; do not write aligned or repaired meshes

allowed_controls: dataset expressions as provisional normal controls
scope.boundary_policy: open facial boundaries are permitted and reported; boundary existence alone is not a defect
scope.split_policy: all expressions, corruptions and seeds of one subject inherit its split; held-out subjects never tune thresholds
